rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something done or happening at the latest possible moment.

example.english: Our last-minute change to the itinerary left everyone scrambling.
example.traditional: 我哋最後一刻先改行程，搞到大家都好狼狽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 haak1 sin1 goi2 hang4 cing4 gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 long4 bui3

rows.note: Use this for a last-minute situation involving urgency, haste, or short notice.

example.english: They gave me last-minute notice about the meeting—how could I find the materials in time?
example.traditional: 臨急先通知我開會，邊度搵得切資料呀？
example.jyutping: lam4 gap1 sin1 tung1 zi1 ngo5 hoi1 wui2 bin1 dou6 wan2 dak1 cit3 zi1 liu2 aa3

rows.note: Use this when something happens just in time and successfully prevents it from being too late.

example.english: You paid in time and avoided a last-minute cancellation.
example.traditional: 你及時過數，先至冇畀人取消張單。
example.jyutping: nei5 kap6 si4 gwo3 sou3 sin1 zi3 mou5 bei2 jan4 ceoi2 siu1 zoeng1 daan1
